items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Turk Murphy. I said, “Turk Murphy. Look, there’s a sign in front of that nightclub. Turk Murphy plays there.”

ctx.x: Turk Murphy. I said, “Turk Murphy. Look, there’s a sign in front of that nightclub. Turk Murphy plays there.” My little son, Darius, said, “Stop. We should hear Turk Murphy.” I said, “What do you know about Turk Murphy?” He goes, [Brubeck sings a melody popularized by Murphy]. I said, “How could you . . .?” He said, “You’ve got a Turk Murphy recording at home.” Do you remember that song?
